lines.x: US stocks recorded their strongest daily performance in 18 months following the Democratic party's victory in Congressional elections.

The Nasdaq fell 2.9% amid growing expectations of a December Federal Reserve interest rate hike, alongside a technology stock selloff, weak Chinese purchasing managers' index data, and higher oil prices.
Democrats won control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives in the US midterm elections, following over $11.9 billion in campaign spending.
Global stock markets surged 3% while gold prices climbed above $4,000 per ounce.
